The Ruby Sanctum is the red dragonflight's sanctum within the Chamber of Aspects beneath Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. It is accessed via a crack in the ice following the Path of the Titans. It is a raid dungeon with both 10 and 25-player normal and heroic modes.
The dungeon's release was delayed until patch 3.3.5a was released in Europe, a week after the US release, in an effort to make sure all players world-wide could access it at the same time. Even so, a large number of both US and EU realms were down for a 24-hour maintenance when the raid was opened.

{{Race|TwilightDragonflight}} | boss = {{RaceIcon|DragonTwilight}} [[Halion]] | type = Raid | level = 80 - 83 | players = 10/25 |crossfaction=1 | bosses = {{Ruby Sanctum}} }} {{Chamber of Aspects wings}} The '''Ruby Sanctum''' is the [[red dragonflight]]'s sanctum within the [[Chamber of Aspects]] beneath [[Wyrmrest Temple]] in [[Dragonblight]]. It is accessed via a crack in the ice following the [[Path of the Titans]]. It is a raid dungeon with both 10 and 25-player normal and heroic modes. The dungeon's release was delayed until patch [[3.3.5a]] was released in Europe, a week after the US release, in an effort to make sure all players world-wide could access it at the same time. Even so, a large number of both US and EU realms were down for a 24-hour maintenance when the raid was opened.{{ref web |url=http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/thread.html?topicId=25171669763&sid=1 |title=Patch 3.3.5 - Ruby Sanctum Availability |accessdate=2010-06-03 |author=Zarhym |date=2010-06-01 |quote= The Ruby Sanctum will not immediately be available on North American realms upon the release of the patch.}} ==History== {{Wotlk-section}} [[File:Ruby Sanctum HS.png|thumb|The {{HS|Ruby Sanctum}} in {{g|hs}}.]] When a clutch of [[twilight dragonflight]] eggs was discovered within the [[Obsidian Sanctum]], [[Korialstrasz]] asked the [[Council of Six]] to send adventurers to destroy them. The deed was done quickly, and without fanfare or acknowledgment. At first all seemed quiet, but then all communication with the guardians in the Ruby Sanctum ceased. The guards stationed at the portal were slain, and the mystic stones shattered. The implications of the Ruby Sanctum being breached are dire, and little is known of the identity of the attackers, as the [[black dragonflight]]'s numbers in [[Northrend]] seem too limited to have pulled off such an attack. What power would dare to attack the stronghold of the red dragonflight, and how did they get past the guards undetected?http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/underdev/3p3/rubysanctum.xml As the black dragonflight attacked the sanctum in retaliation,''[[Exploring Azeroth: Northrend]]'', pg. 81 the black dragons' targets were the red dragons' eggs.{{text|say|Sanctum Guardian Xerestrasza|They slaughtered us with cold efficiency, but the true focus of their interest seemed to be the eggs kept here in the Sanctum.}} ===Cataclysm and aftermath=== {{Novel-section}} Some time after the [[Shattering]], the [[Twilight's Hammer]] invaded the Ruby Sanctum in order to corrupt the eggs within. Korialstrasz was forced to destroy both himself and not only this sanctum but all of them in order to stop them, leaving nothing behind except traces of the energy used to destroy them.''[[Thrall: Twilight of the Aspects]]'' The Ruby Sanctum was eventually rebuilt and used to store the very last red dragon eggs and whelps there would ever be.[http://blue.mmo-champion.com/topic/806893-feedback-class-mount-questlines-flying/#post66 Jeremy Feasel official post][https://twitter.com/Muffinus/status/832823180339224576 Jeremy Feasel on Twitter]: "As Senegos mentined, the whelps in the regrown Ruby Sanctum are the last red whelps ever. Will you slay them for 0 achievement points?" This was probably done before the [[Dragon Soul]] raid, as after that the dragons became sterile. Either that, or the eggs existed before the raid in other locations and the sanctum was rebuilt to keep them safe after it became clear there would be no more. {{Legion-section}} The [[Adventurer|Deathlord]] of the [[Knights of the Ebon Blade]] travels to the rebuilt Ruby Sanctum to obtain information on [[Kyranastrasz|a great dragon skeleton]] north of [[Icecrown]]. The [[Lich King]] gives the Deathlord the option of either sparing some dragons within, or slaying them all. However, the dragons are aggressive to the Deathlord regardless.[[Draconic Secrets]] {{Novel-section}} As of the awakening of the [[Dragon Isles]], the sanctum once again hosts dragon eggs, guarded by sanctum's dragonkin guardians.{{Ref WoWCodex|161}} ==Geography== [[File:Red Chamber 3.3.5.jpg|thumb|Instance portal.]] ===Map=== File:WorldMap-TheRubySanctum.jpg|Map of the Ruby Sanctum. ==Encounters== The [[black dragonflight]] has assaulted the sanctum and is attempting to destroy it to facilitate [[Deathwing|Deathwing's]] reemergence into [[Azeroth]]. [[Halion]] will be the primary encounter, along with three mini-encounters that must be completed prior to him. Unlike the [[Obsidian Sanctum]], there are no progressive hard modes from leaving up some or all of the minibosses. Loot is comparable to that of [[Lich King (tactics)|The Lich King]]. Heroic Encounter of Halion [[Item Level]] 284, possible end-game content until the release of Cataclysm. ==Denizens== [[File:Ruby sanctum bosses.jpg|thumb|The Ruby Sanctum bosses.]] ===Bosses and monsters=== {|class="darktable zebra" !Bosses !Monsters !NPCs |-valign=top | *{{RaceIcon|DragonTwilight}} [[Halion]] *{{RaceIcon|DrakeBlack}} [[Saviana Ragefire]] *{{RaceIcon|DrakonidBlack}} [[Baltharus the Warborn]] *{{RaceIcon|OverlordBlack}} [[General Zarithrian]] **{{RaceIcon|SpawnBlack Female}} [[Onyx Flamecaller]] | *{{RaceIcon|DrakonidBlack}} [[Charscale Assaulter]] *{{RaceIcon|OverlordBlack}} [[Charscale Commander]] *{{RaceIcon|SpawnBlack}} [[Charscale Elite]] *{{RaceIcon|SpawnBlack Female}} [[Charscale Invoker]] | *{{RaceIcon|DragonRed}}{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Female}} {{NPC||Sanctum Guardian Xerestrasza}} |} ==Notes== *Due to a bug, the Ruby Sanctum's reset time appeared briefly on the calendar during [[patch 3.3.3]]. *The {{HS|Ruby Sanctum}} appears as a rare priest location in the {{HS|CATACLYSM}} expansion in {{G|HS}}. ==Gallery== Halion.jpg Rs02.jpg Rs03.jpg Rs04.jpg Rs05.jpg WorldMap-TheRubySanctumDKMountScenario.jpg|Ruby Sanctum map in the quest [[:Draconic Secrets]].
